# Test fixtures – official price-transparency formats

These files follow the XML structures published by Israeli retailers under the Food Act price-transparency
regulations (PriceFull / Price / PromoFull / Stores, including the chain-specific variants handled by the parser).

**All values are synthetic test data.** Chain code 7290000000001 and barcodes 729999000001x are invented
test identifiers with valid check digits; they do not refer to real retailers or products. Real files must be
obtained from the retailers' official publication portals (see docs/INTEGRATIONS.md).
